mentions.name: Lite³
mentions.description: A binary format that encodes JSON documents as a serialized B-tree, so iterators can be constructed directly on the serialized document and internal fields queried at indexed speeds without parsing. Documents remain serialized and can be sent over a network.
mentions.problem: JSON documents normally have to be parsed before their internal fields can be queried; Lite³ is already indexed while serialized, so no parsing step is needed.
mentions.source_excerpt: Lite³: a binary format encoding JSON documents as a serialized B-tree, making it possible to construct iterators on them directly and query internal fields at indexed speeds.
